versions.content: pncSynchronousWakeup is set to TRUE and at least one ex- plicitWakeupPnc reference If CommunicationConnector.createEcuWake- upSource is set to TRUE, EcuInstance.pncSynchronousWakeup is set to TRUE and at least one CommunicationConnector.explicitWakeupPnc reference is defined, then a dedicated wakeup source for this CommunicationConnector is de- rived and that wakeup source wakes exactly those PNCs that are referenced by Com- municationConnector.explicitWakeupPnc . The CommunicationConnector is assigned to this wakeup source.
